auth.label: API Token
auth.description: ProcessPlan API token sent with the tkn_id header. Create a token from your ProcessPlan user profile: https://processplan.com/docs/api-documentation/authentication/.

actions.name: list_my_pending_tasks
actions.description: List pending ProcessPlan tasks assigned to the current API token user.

take.description: The maximum number of records to return.

skip.description: The number of records to skip before returning results.

inputSchema.description: Pagination and filtering options for pending tasks.

items.description: A ProcessPlan object whose documented fields depend on the configured process template.

tasks.description: The pending tasks assigned to the current user.

outputSchema.description: The current user's pending ProcessPlan task list.

actions.name: list_process_instances
actions.description: List ProcessPlan process instances, optionally limited to one template and status.

processTemplateId.description: The process template ID whose instances should be listed.

status.description: The process instance status to list, or all for the unfiltered list endpoint.

take.description: The maximum number of records to return.

skip.description: The number of records to skip before returning results.

items.description: A ProcessPlan object whose documented fields depend on the configured process template.

actions.name: list_process_templates
actions.description: List ProcessPlan process templates that the current user can start.

take.description: The maximum number of records to return.

skip.description: The number of records to skip before returning results.

inputSchema.description: Pagination and filtering options for process templates.

items.description: A ProcessPlan object whose documented fields depend on the configured process template.

processTemplates.description: The process templates available to start.

actions.name: start_process
actions.description: Start a ProcessPlan process from a template and optionally populate its fields.

processTemplateId.description: The ProcessPlan process template ID to start.

additionalProperties.description: The value assigned to the ProcessPlan field.

fields.description: Initial process field values keyed by the field names configured in ProcessPlan.

inputSchema.description: The template and optional initial field values for a new process.

processInstance.description: A ProcessPlan object whose documented fields depend on the configured process template.

outputSchema.description: The newly started ProcessPlan process instance.
